caption: The drawing shows a single transparent glass mug with a handle, positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The mug features decorative painted designs on its surface. On one side of the mug there is a yellow banner with the text "remember" partially visible, and underneath the banner, there is a prominent red flower with a dark center. Surrounding the flower and banner, there are green leaves, small orange flowers with yellow centers, and white decorative flourishes. The mug has a ribbed pattern at the bottom and is rendered with highlights to give it a glass-like, reflective appearance. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Friendship Mug
